# Getting help with EverythingBox

**Questions, setup problems, "is this supposed to happen?"** → the Discord:
<https://discord.gg/bW7KMVhgwH>

Post in `#support`, and say which platform you are on (Windows / macOS / Linux /
Android TV / iOS) and which area you are in (video, audio, emulation, add-ons,
themes, readers). Attach `stream_debug.log` from the app data directory —
Settings ▸ Debug shows its tail in-app and can open its folder, and it is
usually the fastest route to a diagnosis. Mark the thread **Solved** when it is,
so that the next person with the same problem finds the answer instead of
asking again.

**A reproducible bug, or a feature proposal** → the
[issue tracker](https://github.com/cubman3134/EverythingBox/issues/new/choose).
Those need to stay searchable and stay open until they are fixed, and chat is
bad at both.

**Contributing code** → [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) first; it lists the
conventions that actually get a pull request rejected. Then `#dev-general`.
